# MaVe

> Canonical URL: https://mauroverberkt.github.io/MaVe/
> Repository: https://github.com/MauroVerberkt/MaVe
>
> Functional patterns for .NET: Result<T>, Option<T>, discriminated unions, and a
> source-generated business rule framework. Production-grade NuGet packages for C# 12+ / .NET 8+.

## Documentation

- [Architecture Overview](https://mauroverberkt.github.io/MaVe/architecture/overview): System design, package relationships, and principles
- [Installation](https://mauroverberkt.github.io/MaVe/docs/getting-started/installation): NuGet packages and setup
- [Quick Start](https://mauroverberkt.github.io/MaVe/docs/getting-started/quick-start): First steps with the libraries
- [Result Monad](https://mauroverberkt.github.io/MaVe/docs/monads/result/): Error handling without exceptions — Map, Bind, Match
- [Option Monad](https://mauroverberkt.github.io/MaVe/docs/monads/option/): Nullable replacement with monadic composition
- [Monads Overview](https://mauroverberkt.github.io/MaVe/docs/monads/overview): Design philosophy and patterns
- [Discriminated Unions](https://mauroverberkt.github.io/MaVe/docs/unions/overview): Source-generated unions with exhaustive matching
- [Business Rules](https://mauroverberkt.github.io/MaVe/docs/business-rules/overview): Source-generated rule framework with Roslyn analyzers
- [Result Extensions](https://mauroverberkt.github.io/MaVe/docs/business-rules/result-extensions): Bridge between BusinessRules and Result<T>

## Architecture

- [Decisions](https://mauroverberkt.github.io/MaVe/architecture/decisions/): Architecture Decision Records (ADRs)
- [Proposals](https://mauroverberkt.github.io/MaVe/architecture/proposals/): Active design proposals

## Packages

- [MaVe.Monads](https://www.nuget.org/packages/MaVe.Monads): Result<T> and Option<T> monadic types
- [MaVe.Unions](https://www.nuget.org/packages/MaVe.Unions): Discriminated unions with source generation and Roslyn analyzers
- [MaVe.BusinessRules](https://www.nuget.org/packages/MaVe.BusinessRules): Source-generated business rule framework
- [MaVe.BusinessRules.ResultExtensions](https://www.nuget.org/packages/MaVe.BusinessRules.ResultExtensions): Bridge between MaVe.BusinessRules and MaVe.Monads
- [MaVe.BusinessRules.Wcf](https://www.nuget.org/packages/MaVe.BusinessRules.Wcf): WCF fault exception support for business rule violations
